name: rust
description: For the planner, builder and reviewer of a task that writes Rust in agent-team's Cargo workspace: the rust-core skill, which gives the core's rules (every case of the workspace's own enums handled, no panic outside a test, no unsafe, no dependency a ticket does not name), names the choices not made yet, sends the session to a dependency's real interface at the version Cargo.lock pins, and gives the one check to end on, tests/run rust; rust-analyzer as a language server for navigation only, its pushed diagnostics off and its cargo calls held to two jobs; a session-start hook that holds the session's own cargo calls to the team's CPU budget with sccache as their compiler wrapper; and a post-edit hook that gives the session cargo clippy's findings on each Rust file it edits. No MCP server.
